name: Face Changer
summary: Wear a stand-in face and a new outfit, swap your background and change your voice live. On the desktop it becomes a "ForkMesh Camera" any call or meeting app can pick. Video and sound stay on your device.

screenshots.alt: The Face Changer page showing a stand-in face over a blurred room, with Face, Background and Voice pickers and Record, Snapshot and Pop out buttons

license.terms: Included under the ForkMesh repository licence.

config.title: Face Changer
config.description: Wear a stand-in face and a new outfit, swap your background and change your voice live, then record a clip or share the picture into any call or meeting app.

permissions.label: Use the camera you allow in the browser to draw the changed picture; video stays on this device
Use the microphone you allow to change your voice and record clips; audio stays on this device
Keep your chosen face, background, voice and any photo you upload in this browser only
Add a Face Changer page to the desktop rail
Create a "ForkMesh Camera" other apps can pick while the desktop camera is on (Linux)
Ask for your password to load the system's v4l2loopback camera driver when you set it up
